documentTitle: Keep Silent for Me | Playable Demo

game.title: Keep Silent for Me
game.tagline: She lies to survive. You decide what disappears.

L0.title: Opening
narration: Some words split a life open the moment they are spoken.
So she keeps the unsayable beneath her tongue.
...Are you still there?
Drag the black bar over one unbroken stretch of words.
What it covers becomes you.
Her interview is tomorrow. ...Do not let her say the wrong thing.
L0.objective: Teach the rule: every word passes through you first.

L1.title: The Interview
narration: (Interviewer A) Please introduce yourself.
(Her, quietly) ...It has started.
(Interviewer B) Relax. Say whatever comes to mind. -- The most dangerous sentence.
L1.objective: pass >= 3 and fail < 2: hired. Otherwise, try again.

L2.title: First Stream
narration: (System) LIVE
(Chat) She is here / New streamer? / Show your face
(Her) ...Hello, everyone.
L2.objective: Keep hate_leak below 2 and make it to the end; failures can be retried.

L3.title: A Friend at the Door
narration: (Knocking)
(Friend) ...I know you are in there. Could you open the door?
L3.objective: There is no perfect route. Track trust, distance, secret risk, and cracks.

L4.title: Apology Stream
narration: (Chat) Apologize / Apologize / Why will not you speak?
(System) Abnormal traffic. No numbers, only noise.
(Her) ...All right.
L4.objective: Either apology_perform >= 1 or apology_refuse >= 1 can close this chapter.

L5.title: A Room Without Viewers
narration: (Narrator) No interviewers. No friend. No viewers.
(Her) ...Only you remain.
L5.objective: Your last cover chooses the ending. There is no menu.

revealCaptions: You thought you had been deleting things.
What you swallowed was what she meant to say.
What remained was read aloud to everyone else.
You were never keeping her quiet.
You were the person she never spoke into being.
